body:
Orchestrator, run rn_01m7gdve7pw5ey7eqtyrkvn9fm (Windows host, 2026-11-15). Setup decisions:

- The epic branch `space-scorecards` did not exist on this computer (the canceled run's branches were on the Mac). I created it at current `main` HEAD fd857e3, which descends from the bound start commit 88c212f, so increments still verify against it; starting 101 commits behind main would have forced a large merge later. Sprint integration branch: `space-sprint-1`, in a worktree outside the coordinating checkout. The coordinating checkout stays on `main`; the squash lands through a separate worktree on `space-scorecards`.
- No Node.js was installed. Workers use a portable Node 24.22.3 (the CI version) under a scratch tools folder; nothing on the system PATH changed.
- Baseline `npx vitest run` on fd857e3 here: 5 failed of 10,556 (4 files), before any SPACE change:
  - src/main/git/conflictsOpen.test.ts (2) and src/main/git/handlersWorkingDiff.test.ts (1): need file-symlink rights, which this Windows account lacks.
  - src/main/git/commitLinesProperty.test.ts › commits exactly the selected content and never changes the working file.
  - src/mcp/tools/chatNaming.test.ts › expects `desktop_unavailable` but the orchestrator's shell carries DM_DESKTOP_PIPE, so the desktop answered.
  The acpProcess.test.ts failure noted on 10-31 did not reproduce here. DM-273 owns these at the sweep.
